description: This file defines the CUDAStream class, an abstraction over CUDA streams in PyTorch, including stream pooling, querying, synchronization, and conversion functionalities.

classes.name: c10::cuda::CUDAStream
classes.description: A wrapper class representing a CUDA stream with additional CUDA-specific functionality, including conversion, query, synchronization, and packing.

methods.name: CUDAStream
methods.description: Constructor that creates a CUDAStream from a c10::Stream, with optional unchecked construction.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison between two CUDAStream objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between two CUDAStream objects.

methods.name: device_type
methods.description: Returns the device type, which is CUDA.

methods.name: device_index
methods.description: Returns the device index associated with the stream.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the Device object representing the CUDA device.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Checks if the stream has completed its tasks.

methods.name: priority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the stream.

methods.name: pack3
methods.description: Packs the stream into a struct representation.

methods.name: unpack3
methods.description: Unpacks a stream from its struct representation.

methods.name: priority_range
methods.description: Returns the supported priority range for CUDA streams.
